author: Xuph
body:
i have never actually understood the purpose of that. it may seem to you something that is simple as, and very ok, but after thinking about what it actually does, i decided create this discussion topic.

locking: closing the topic from further discussion.

locking prevents others opinions on the topic. its stupid, and pointless. just saw the official announcement about the future of avicus thingy sessp made, and i cringed so badly and i hope my face will come back to what it was before. 

you DONT need to lock topics for this reason. it wasn't even a flame war, it was a discussion. if you think this gives a bad view on the server and you lock it because of that, then let me tell you that locking an official announcement post because people voice their opinions freely and having arguments and debates in order to reach a certain situation on the server, it gives a worse view on the server.
people are supposed to voice their opinions freely on posts imo. unless it's offending, it shouldnbt be locked. simple as.

solution: you dont lock topics. you add a forum warn button, i heard ocn has that, but it doesnt matter. you have that. once a player goes on posting offensive posts you warn them using the magical button and ARCHIVE HIS POST, NOT LOCK IT. if player is going way off topic, and by off topic i dont mean having arguements with admins about a certain situation that relates to the server like in the topic i mentioned before, by off topic i mean talking about having a relatoinship with a printer on a topic that is "rate the person about you in mineman pvp".

in a nuthshell, you dont need to lock topics. if person is doing something wrong, forum warn then using the button i suggested, and they will recieve it in their alerts. next time, itll be a longer punishment like forum ban. you simply archive their topic and whoever responded to them, and keep the discussion going. also dont be so harsh on archieving post, people sometimes just meme for fun.

so what is your opinion, should locking topics stay as it is or should it change? if yes, how?

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Archiving is for removing threads/posts out of sight of the community, because they severely break the forum rules.
Locking is for ending the said discussion because it has either a) become off-topic or b) it's become a flame war.

Yes I just said flame war topics should be public; but locked; with any posts that are vulgar/racist/leaking etc. archived - the staff team shouldn't be paranoid in allowing the community to only see the clean, calm and respected side of forum discussions.

I didn't mention unnecessary bumps, because that post should be archived and hopefully the bump will spark the said, old thread alive again; allowing an even greater variety of threads to be active. However, if after the bump there is excessive off-topic discussions then a lock would be suitable.

Just my opinion. c;

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Locking
Locking prevents any further comments from any users. The general rule for locking is if you want people to see the thread but not respond to the thread, then it should be locked.
Types of threads that should be locked:
  • Information threads.
  • Question threads (once it has been answered).
  • Threads that have gone a bit to far off topic.
  • Flame war threads.
Archiving
A thread should be archived when the sole purpose of the thread is to:
  • Advertise other minecraft networks/services
  • Create spam on the forums
  • Contains offensive content
If the thread has a good purpose and people should be able to see everything except a particular post someone made then the post should be archived.
